prompts.positive: [Instrumental] Create a 3-minute premium instrumental track for motivation and sustained focus. Genre: Electronic; subgenres: Dance, Electronica, House. Mood: Energizing, Hopeful, Inspiring, Optimistic, Playful, Upbeat, Uplifting. Tempo: 116 BPM in a steady 4/4 meter. Use a restrained arpeggiated pulse in the background, never a piercing lead, rounded electric-key chords with natural attack and decay, controlled electronic percussion with a steady even pulse, sparse organic percussion accents with humanized dynamics, wide processed string texture with slow evolving movement, a warm controlled synth-bass foundation focused in the low-mid range, a soft atmospheric synth pad that supports the harmony without masking it, a low-contrast textural soundscape that leaves space for the motif. Keep the tonal character balanced and warm, the arrangement sparse, and the mix clear, deep, and mature. Start with a restrained tonal introduction under 10 seconds, establish the main pulse quickly, then develop contrasting 16-to-32-bar phrases with small changes in harmony, register, countermelody, and texture. Build energy through musical development rather than a drop. End with a resolved, crossfade-friendly outro and never repeat one short loop unchanged.
